rows.name: block_aliases_workspace_alias_unique
rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER block_aliases_workspace_alias_unique
  BEFORE INSERT ON block_aliases
  WHEN (SELECT source FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1) IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.alias != ''
  BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT,
      'alias_collision' || char(31) ||
      hex(NEW.workspace_id) || char(31) ||
      hex(NEW.alias) || char(31) ||
      hex(NEW.block_id)
    )
    WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM block_aliases
      WHERE workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id
        AND alias = NEW.alias
        AND block_id != NEW.block_id
    );
  END

rows.name: blocks_alias_insert

CREATE TRIGGER blocks_alias_insert
  AFTER INSERT ON blocks
  WHEN NEW.deleted = 0
  BEGIN
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO block_aliases (block_id, workspace_id, alias, alias_lower)
      SELECT NEW.id, NEW.workspace_id, je.value, LOWER(je.value)
      FROM json_each(NEW.properties_json, '$.alias') AS je
      WHERE typeof(je.value) = 'text';
  END

  BEGIN
    DELETE FROM block_aliases WHERE block_id = NEW.id;
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO block_aliases (block_id, workspace_id, alias, alias_lower)
    SELECT NEW.id, NEW.workspace_id, je.value, LOWER(je.value)
    FROM json_each(NEW.properties_json, '$.alias') AS je
    WHERE NEW.deleted = 0 AND typeof(je.value) = 'text';
  END

blocks_fts_insert

CREATE TRIGGER blocks_fts_insert
  AFTER INSERT ON blocks
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO blocks_fts_rowids (block_id)
      SELECT NEW.id
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM blocks_fts_rowids WHERE block_id = NEW.id
      );
      INSERT INTO blocks_fts (rowid, content, workspace_id, block_id)
      SELECT fts_rowid, NEW.content, NEW.workspace_id, NEW.id
      FROM blocks_fts_rowids
      WHERE block_id = NEW.id
        AND NEW.deleted = 0
        AND NEW.content != '';
  END

rows.name: blocks_fts_update

CREATE TRIGGER blocks_fts_update
  AFTER UPDATE OF content, deleted, workspace_id ON blocks
  BEGIN
    DELETE FROM blocks_fts
    WHERE rowid = (
      SELECT fts_rowid FROM blocks_fts_rowids WHERE block_id = OLD.id
    );
    INSERT INTO blocks_fts_rowids (block_id)
      SELECT NEW.id
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM blocks_fts_rowids WHERE block_id = NEW.id
      );
      INSERT INTO blocks_fts (rowid, content, workspace_id, block_id)
      SELECT fts_rowid, NEW.content, NEW.workspace_id, NEW.id
      FROM blocks_fts_rowids
      WHERE block_id = NEW.id
        AND NEW.deleted = 0
        AND NEW.content != '';
  END

      SELECT

rows.name: blocks_row_event_delete
rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER blocks_row_event_delete
  AFTER DELETE ON blocks
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO row_events (
      tx_id, block_id, kind, before_json, after_json, source, created_at, group_id
    ) VALUES (
      CASE
        WHEN (SELECT source FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1) IS NULL
          THEN NULL
        ELSE (SELECT tx_id FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1)
      END,
      OLD.id,
      'delete',
      json_object(
        'id', OLD.id,
        'workspaceId', OLD.workspace_id,
        'parentId', OLD.parent_id,
        'referenceTargetId', OLD.reference_target_id,
        'isFieldForm', json(CASE WHEN OLD.is_field_form = 1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),
        'orderKey', OLD.order_key,
        'content', OLD.content,
        'properties', json(OLD.properties_json),
        'references', json(OLD.references_json),
        'createdAt', OLD.created_at,
        'updatedAt', OLD.updated_at,
        'userUpdatedAt', coalesce(OLD.user_updated_at, OLD.updated_at),
        'createdBy', OLD.created_by,
        'updatedBy', OLD.updated_by,
        'deleted', json(CASE WHEN OLD.deleted THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END)
      ),
      NULL,
      COALESCE((SELECT source FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1), 'sync'),
      CAST((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER),
      CASE
        WHEN (SELECT source FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1) IS NULL
          THEN NULL
        ELSE (SELECT group_id FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1)
      END
    );
  END

CREATE TRIGGER blocks_type_update
  AFTER UPDATE OF properties_json, deleted, workspace_id ON blocks
  BEGIN
    DELETE FROM block_types WHERE block_id = NEW.id;
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO block_types (block_id, workspace_id, type)
    SELECT NEW.id, NEW.workspace_id, je.value
    FROM json_each(NEW.properties_json, '$.types') AS je
    WHERE NEW.deleted = 0 AND typeof(je.value) = 'text';
  END

rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER blocks_upload_insert
  AFTER INSERT ON blocks
  WHEN (SELECT source FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1) IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO ps_crud (tx_id, data) VALUES (
      (SELECT tx_seq FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1),
      json_object(
        'op', 'PUT',
        'type', 'blocks',
        'id', NEW.id,
        'data', json_object(
        'workspace_id', NEW.workspace_id,
        'parent_id', NEW.parent_id,
        'order_key', NEW.order_key,
        'content', NEW.content,
        'properties_json', NEW.properties_json,
        'references_json', NEW.references_json,
        'created_at', NEW.created_at,
        'updated_at', NEW.updated_at,
        'user_updated_at', NEW.user_updated_at,
        'created_by', NEW.created_by,
        'updated_by', NEW.updated_by,
        'deleted', json(CASE WHEN NEW.deleted THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END)
      )
      )
    );
  END

rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER blocks_upload_update
  AFTER UPDATE ON blocks
  WHEN (SELECT source FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1) IS NOT NULL
    AND (
    OLD.workspace_id IS NOT NEW.workspace_id
    OR OLD.parent_id IS NOT NEW.parent_id
    OR OLD.order_key IS NOT NEW.order_key
    OR OLD.content IS NOT NEW.content
    OR OLD.properties_json IS NOT NEW.properties_json
    OR OLD.references_json IS NOT NEW.references_json
    OR OLD.created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at
    OR OLD.updated_at IS NOT NEW.updated_at
    OR OLD.user_updated_at IS NOT NEW.user_updated_at
    OR OLD.created_by IS NOT NEW.created_by
    OR OLD.updated_by IS NOT NEW.updated_by
    OR OLD.deleted IS NOT NEW.deleted
    )
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO ps_crud (tx_id, data) VALUES (
      (SELECT tx_seq FROM tx_context WHERE id = 1),
      json_object(
        'op', 'PATCH',
        'type', 'blocks',
        'id', NEW.id,
        'data', json_remove(
        json_set(
          '{}',
          '$.workspace_id', NEW.workspace_id,
          CASE WHEN OLD.parent_id IS NOT NEW.parent_id THEN '$.parent_id' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.parent_id,
          CASE WHEN OLD.order_key IS NOT NEW.order_key THEN '$.order_key' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.order_key,
          CASE WHEN OLD.content IS NOT NEW.content THEN '$.content' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.content,
          CASE WHEN OLD.properties_json IS NOT NEW.properties_json THEN '$.properties_json' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.properties_json,
          CASE WHEN OLD.references_json IS NOT NEW.references_json THEN '$.references_json' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.references_json,
          CASE WHEN OLD.created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at THEN '$.created_at' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.created_at,
          CASE WHEN OLD.updated_at IS NOT NEW.updated_at THEN '$.updated_at' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.updated_at,
          CASE WHEN OLD.user_updated_at IS NOT NEW.user_updated_at THEN '$.user_updated_at' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.user_updated_at,
          CASE WHEN OLD.created_by IS NOT NEW.created_by THEN '$.created_by' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.created_by,
          CASE WHEN OLD.updated_by IS NOT NEW.updated_by THEN '$.updated_by' ELSE '$.__noop' END, NEW.updated_by,
          CASE WHEN OLD.deleted IS NOT NEW.deleted THEN '$.deleted' ELSE '$.__noop' END, json(CASE WHEN NEW.deleted THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END)
        ),
        '$.__noop'
      )
      )
    );
  END
